messages.text: I found the copy from the county folder. It has the old St. Joseph's entry and your first little footprint page.
Perfect, thank you. I need the hospital line and the date line for the benefits form.
If you stop by Sunday, remind me to send you home with the old green binder. It has the tab system from my bookkeeping class.
The one with all the color-coded invoice examples?
The date line is 6/14/97. I will put it in the blue folder before Sunday dinner.
Yes. I used the same idea for grower accounts and truck tickets for years. It still works better than half the new software.
I want to see the route notes too. Your margins are always cleaner than mine.
Portal says renewal packets are ready. It only shows our names for signatures.
Good. I can sign after dinner. Did it ask about extra key cards again?
Yes, same checkbox. I left it blank unless you want one for your mom.
Leave it blank. She just visits for an hour here and there.
Utility email came through. Your half is $84. I can wait until Friday if you want to line it up with your bank day.
Friday is fine. I already moved rent out of the first check and left the second one for utilities/groceries.
Cool. Same split as usual then?
Yes. I planned March around the normal two deposits, not the bigger February total.
Mom said you were stopping at the pharmacy after shift. Need anything from Lakewood while I'm out?
Mom asked if you're coming early Sunday or just dinner.
I'm good. Just doing the two-arm errand before I talk myself out of it.
Just dinner. I want to do the Bluff Lake loop before people are out.
Lol brave. Check the real spacing chart this time, not some uncle's Facebook science.
Already looked at my clinic portal and the state page. They both say same-day is fine.
Classic. Family room full of aunties or empty trail with geese yelling.
The geese make more sense to me most weeks.
Did you ever call about that tooth estimate, or are we still making soup recipes the whole month?
I called after shift. They said the lab cap can wait if I keep the temporary piece calm, so I moved it to late April.
Late April gives you a couple more checks at least. Also ask the front desk to run both codes through your card before you hand them money.
Yeah, I am bringing the little benefits card and the estimate sheet this time instead of guessing.
Cold start this morning. Give the older loader a minute before pushing it.
I saw the low-temp alert on the tablet. I am doing fluids first, then the 7:10 gravel run.
Check under it after warmup too. Those hoses get stiff.
Already on my list with forks, bucket pins, and the south gate route.
Found your old binder in the garage. Still has the air-brake notes and the loader checklist from when you first started at the lot.
Keep it on the bench? I need the checklist pages for that Level III packet.
Still need those old crane photos from the Brighton job?
Those new steel toes break in better if you oil them once before the first long shift.
Good call. I saved the receipt too, since work said the boot money comes back after payroll sees it.
Yes, if you have them. The one with the utility poles behind the cab would help with the page on my angled desk.
Will do. Also marked the section on pre-shift walkarounds. That one always gets people.
Thanks. I’m comparing it with the 501 notes before I send anything in.
Keep the toe caps dry. Cheap pairs split fast.
I will send after dinner. Manuals on the shelf might have better boom angles too.
I spent more for the pair that should last. Skipping the nicer jacket I was looking at.
Good call. I have the paper taped down and a quiet playlist going, so I can compare both.
If the Civic is chirping on cold start, look at the belt before you buy anything.
I found a 9-minute YouTube clip showing the tensioner angle. Going to pause it at the garage table and compare.
Use the longer handle. Don't round the bolt.
That's the plan. If it is just the belt, I'd rather spend Saturday on it than hand over shop labor.
I put chili on the menu for Sunday. Your dad says bring back the small cooler if it is still in your trunk.
I have it. I can come after my early shift and bring cornbread.
That works. Call me Saturday when you know your timing, please.
The apartment screening form is asking for anything court-related from the last 7 years. Do you need me to leave that section blank for us?
Blank is fine for me. The only flashing-lights story I have is that old taillight stop where I fixed it the next day.
Xcel posted. Total is $94.26 this time.
Got it. I sent $47.13 and put the confirmation number on the fridge note.
Good. I figured, but I wanted the lease packet clean before I scan it.
Thanks. I still wish the city made those stops less of a guessing game for people.
Thanks. I will handle water when it shows up, same way as last month.
Perfect. The $1,050 portal payment cleared Monday, so only these smaller ones are left.
DAM Friday still good? I saw Juniper Table has the March menu up too.
Museum yes. Food after might be lentils at my place unless the crown charge stops staring at me.
Totally. We can cook and just save the local-grower chalkboard place for later in the month.
That sounds better. I still want the one with the roasted carrots and a beer, just not this week.
I found the flyer from that Civic Center thing I mentioned. Saturday at 2, short route, marshals listed, masks optional.
Still up for museum Saturday? No pressure if work wrung you out.
Send it over. I am only doing it if it stays calm and I can leave before dinner.
Yes. I want to go. Today was just me replaying the trainee sign-off and the rent math in my head like a broken record.
Friday still good for Hamilton? I can meet by the 13th Ave doors at 5:40.
Totally. Also there are two tables taking $5-$20 for bail forms and rent clinic supplies, just FYI.
Then we will look at art and eat something cheaper than a workday burrito. Did your doctor portal ever update after that check-in?
Yes. I may be quiet for a minute after work, but I want to go.
Nothing new listed, just the usual visit notes and the sleep/caffeine tracker suggestion. I am not in some dark hole, I am just tired of my brain auditing every door lock and dollar.
I can spare ten, maybe fifteen. I am not getting dramatic with my budget this week.
Bring the phone pic of those junior-year charcoal pages if you find it. The red note in the corner was sweet.
Found it. Also taped paper to the board tonight so I do not carry the whole shift around with me.
You going in early again?
Saw that flyer about the yard meeting. They still asking for comments on harness checks and heat breaks?
Yeah. Trey is meeting me by the north gate so I can run the checklist past him before Nicole gets there.
Yes. I am sending a note after shift, but only on the part with the inspector staffing and the fine schedule.
Good. Bring your own notes if it turns into a policy talk.
Good. Posters are cheap. Someone has to actually show up at the site.
I printed the handbook page. Payroll questions still have to go through the company portal, so I want the dates straight.
That is exactly why I asked for the page with dates before I sign anything.
Found that old plastic tub from the Aurora garage. Your Rangeview sweatshirt is in there with Marcus's tiny Avs hat.
If you come Sunday, remind me to give you that old orange vest from the garage.
The one with the loader patch on it? I can grab it after dinner.
Keep the sweatshirt if Mom wants the tub cleared. Marcus can fight me for the hat Sunday.
Yeah. Found my wallet cards with it too. Some still have the renewal stickers from Brighton.
He never won those arguments back then either. I will set it by the freezer.
Mom wants the garage shelf sorted anyway, so I will bring a folder.
I saved the chickpea stew recipe. If you bring tortillas, I will handle the lemon and cilantro.
Deal. I can come by after my shift and chop while you roast the peppers.
Also the textile room has evening entry Friday. We could eat first and wander after?
Yes. I have been wanting a quiet museum walk with you after this week.
DAM Friday still good? I can get the 6:30 slot, then City O' City after if you are up for it.
Yes to the exhibit. Dinner is good too, but I am keeping it to one small pour with food. Early equipment day Saturday.
Perfect. I will pick the indoor table this time so we do not end up near the patio door again.
Thank you. I still had that smell in my jacket last time and I do not want to bring it home.
Want to grab dinner after the exhibit Friday, or are you doing your container food thing again?
I packed enough for Friday already. I can do coffee after, but I need to be home early.
Coffee works. I will not tempt you with the museum cafe sandwich.
Thank you. If I am back by 8:45, tomorrow morning is less ugly.
Wind is picking up east of Aurora. Watch the ramp by Peña if you are headed that way.
Thanks. I am taking Tower down first, then the warehouse stop by 56th. Still quicker than crossing town.
Good. Those trucks stack up early near the terminal roads.
Yep, and the planes started before my alarm again. Coffee is doing the heavy lifting.
Wind is ugly up by the foothills this morning. Watch the loose gravel if you go west.
Thanks. I may keep it to the lower loop before work and skip the ridge.
Good. Take water even when it is cool.
Packed already. If dispatch gets messy, I will move it to Sunday.
Your mother found one of those city envelopes under the mail stack. Yours maybe?
Mine is on our counter too. I am bad about the tiny spring ones unless I put a reminder on it.
Big November one you never forget. This little stuff hides.
Exactly. I will look at the guide after shift and see if I can still use the drop box by the library.
I looked at that worksheet you sent. Your March bills are covered if you keep the extra $90 in that separate line and do not touch it for takeout.
That is the plan. I also put the guide deposit in the notes column but left it yellow until I check the cancellation window.
Good. Those road names on the sheet looked very remote, so please budget for the safer option, not only the cheapest one.
I know. The cheaper bus skips the lava fields, so I am comparing the small-group one with the weather backup day.
Are you home from downtown yet? I saw there was a crowd near the Capitol.
Yes, on the train now. It stayed orderly. Mostly signs, speeches, and people passing out water.
Good. Keep your receipt if you put money anywhere, even if it was only a few dollars.
I did. It was $10 at one table and $8 online when I got home.
I moved the heating pad from the couch to your side table. Also wiped down the kitchen.
Thanks. I am doing the doorway stretch first, then I will make rice and eggs.
Cool. If your wrist tape is still in the drawer, I did not touch it.
Perfect. I only use it on long equipment days now.
Do you want to cook after the museum or grab something nearby?
Cook, probably. I already bought rice and those thin chicken packs, so I can make bowls fast.
Works for me. I can bring a sauce so it doesn't taste like your budget spreadsheet.
Please do. The receipt from Tuesday was enough motivation to skip the museum cafe.
Saw your picture of that little yard hauler. No seat in it?
No seat. It follows the lane markers and stops if someone crosses. The part I kept staring at was the battery pack and how the brakes are laid out.
Ask who fixes it at 2 in the morning. Fancy is fine until nobody can get a cover off.
Exactly. I wrote that down with charger access and whether regular shop tools work on it.
I moved my towels to the bottom shelf. Washer is open after 11.
Perfect. I am doing sheets, then the chicken and rice containers.
Do you need half the big pot or can I use it for soup?
Use it after 1. I want the kitchen cleared before I head to my parents.
You watching tonight or doing responsible adult stuff?
Watching from home. I already moved laundry so I can be on the couch by warmups.
Good. I need your live takes when the Avs do something chaotic.
If they make me yell at my phone again, you will know immediately.
Still coming over for soup Tuesday, or are you chained to that finance app?
Tuesday works. I already pulled the one work form into the app and it did most of the math.
Good. Bring the receipt pile only if it actually changes anything, otherwise I vote soup and museum gossip.
It did not change enough to matter. I am mostly waiting for the same Friday bank rhythm before I decide what to send to savings.
Do you still want the small table from the garage?
Yes, if it fits in my room. Lena and I are trying to keep the shared area clear.
Measure first. I can bring it Sunday after dinner.
Thanks. It would be useful as a little desk, since the living room is already half Lena's setup and half mine.
Did the lender send that payoff estimate for the Subaru yet?
Yeah, still not worth rushing. I kept the regular March amount and only added a little to the card after groceries.
Good. Keep receipts for the dental office forms. If they ask for case numbers again, blank is fine if you do not have one.
I put N/A on those lines and attached pay stubs. Nothing else to attach.
Wind picked up west of town. If you go before dinner, take the heavier jacket.
I checked the gusts. I am just doing the short ridge above Morrison, back before dark.
Good. Watch the gravel on the lower switchback.
I know that spot. I want twenty quiet minutes up there before the chili crowd.
Roads look icy before sunrise tomorrow. Give yourself extra time getting to the yard.
I will. I am opening again and then staying for the safety walk at 2:30.
Same gate as always?
Yes, west gate. My badge still works there from the old 2022 setup, somehow.
Did you still want the heating pad on the couch today or can I put it back in the hall closet?
You can put it back. Both arms are just a little sore now, nothing weird.
Good. My office keeps telling people to use the official symptom checker if they get unsure.
That's what I saved. It matched what the nurse line said, so I'm not fussing with random threads.
Tire shop said that sidewall bubble is not worth waiting on. Quote was right around $400 with mounting.
Thanks. I can handle that if it has to happen before payday, but I want to see what posts this week first.
Good. Do not drive it fast until then.
I won't. I'll call them after I update my sheet Friday night.
Did your housing payment already come out this month? I am updating the little budget sheet before Sunday.
Yes, $1,050 cleared on the 2nd. I am waiting on the last small utility amount from Lena.
Good. Keep your groceries and gas in your own columns so the totals stay clean.
I do. The shared apartment stuff is the only thing I put on that tab.
I am filling out the table count for Aunt Leela. Should I put you with us for the early part or only the meal?
Only the meal, please. I will stop by after my short walk.
Okay. Wear layers if you are going near the water that early.
I will. That quiet half hour outside helps me show up nicer.
How did the yearly appointment go? I wrote down your time wrong and thought it was tomorrow.
It was quick. Vitals, routine labs, and she laughed that my medicine list is basically sunscreen and the little bottle I carry for rough workdays.
Good. Keep doing the lifting breaks your dad always nags about.
I know. I put a reminder on my phone for the 10:00 and 2:00 breaks.
Fridge space heads up: my top shelf is packed until tomorrow.
No problem. I only need the left drawer for carrots and the container of roasted veg.
Also your Safeway bag is still by the door.
I'll grab it. That bag was $41 even with the card discounts, so nothing in there is getting forgotten.
Are you still doing the 6:30 dirt path thing? I can start rice if you are late.
Canceled it. Training notes went sideways and I am still at my desk.
Ok. I will leave your half in the pan.
Thanks. I will try for the canyon path Saturday morning instead.
Xcel posted. Your half is $74.31 whenever you do the portal stuff.
Got it. I will send it after dinner. The March place charge cleared fine this morning too.
Good. Still cheaper here than the listings Marisol keeps sending, even with the plane windows rattling.
True. I can live with it when my 6 a.m. drive to the dock is only twenty minutes.
You still staring at photos of black rocks and steam vents or did you finally buy something?
Just bookmarking. The jeep day is $214, so I split it across two paychecks in the sheet before I decide.
You alive after the forklift circus or should I send snacks
Alive. Not talking shop yet. I am priming a small canvas first.
You still doing coffee Sunday or are you in spreadsheet jail again lol
Very you. I would click buy and then eat cereal for a week.
Coffee is safe. I just need twenty minutes after dinner to update the bill sheet.
Classic. Did you ever find that folder Mom kept with the 11th grade drawings?
Exactly why I have the little side pot. If the road opens late, I want enough cushion to switch dates.
Because the dental thing?
Yeah. February gave me a little extra room, but I don't want to count on that when the normal month is closer to two checks under two grand each.
Yes, with the sticky that says 'show me more of these.' Marisol wants to see a picture before Saturday.
You still coming for coffee Sunday or are you doing homework like a responsible adult now lol
Coffee first. Then I have to finish the catalog questions before the Monday advising call.
Wild that you skipped campus after senior year and now you’re circling back with spreadsheets.
Different timing. The lot paid me while I learned, and I could build from there.
Mom says you still have the photo from the Peoria house where I'm holding the busted GameCube controller.
Because you were 9 and blamed the dog. I was old enough to know better and still covered for you.
Counter guy tip: don't buy the whole wiper arm unless the little clip is actually busted.
Good, because the channel I watched made the $7 refill look easy if I keep the rail straight.
Legendary teamwork. Dad looked so tired in that picture.
Look at you beating the parts store upsell lol
He had just fixed the fence after work. I'll bring the photo Sunday if I find it.
Barely. I had the phone propped against the washer fluid jug like a tiny instructor.
Museum Friday still okay? I can do 6:30 and then cheap noodles.
Yes. I just need to not buy anything in the shop. This month was work pants, gloves, and the boot upgrade.
I can bring the museum coupons Saturday, and also that little blue-column comparison sheet if you want it.
Bring it. I do not like joining a team on paper, but my marks keep landing on that side lately.
I support sensible pants and noodles. Did payroll fix the missing glove credit?
That sounds very you: no jersey, same side of the court most nights.
They said it lands next check with the 3% retirement line I was checking.
Pretty much. I still read both columns before I seal anything.
The new dispatch screen at my office reordered two farm deliveries around the I-70 slowdown this morning. It saved Miguel from doubling back.
That is the kind of thing I like seeing. Less wasted miles is good, but I always want to know if the drivers can override it without calling three managers.
They can drag a stop manually. The trainer said the company added that after the first week because the drivers complained.
Good. If the people using it have to fight it all day, the fuel savings are just a brochure number.
Your dad left two binders on the kitchen table for you. Please do not let him stack greasy parts on top of them.
Are those the ones with the crane diagrams and the little laminated cards?
Yes, plus the school envelope. He said you would know what to keep.
I will put the cards in sleeves and take photos of the envelope before dinner.
Are you still coming Sunday, or did they add more early loads?
Still coming. I just have to finish the pallet count and fix two stop pins in the route app before I leave tomorrow.
That sounds like dispatch paperwork following you home. Please eat dinner before you start.
I will. The forklift lane got changed, so I want the morning list clean before 6.
Marisol's green container is still on the counter. Do you want it in your tote?
Yes please. I am dropping it with her before we go inside the museum.
Got it. I put the little score notebook in there too, unless that was from Monday.
That is hers too. I would forget half my stuff without you noticing the pile.
Can you swap bathroom week with me? My clinic admin day ran over.
Yes. Mine landed at 42.5 on the card after today's late truck, so I was going to keep Saturday quiet anyway.
Thanks. I will do kitchen and trash after dinner.
Perfect. I already put the rent transfer in before I left the office.
Xcel finally posted. Your half is $86.42.
Sending it after I finish reconciling. March is at $1,129 before groceries tomorrow.
No rush tonight. I just wanted it off my list.
Appreciate it. I still want the little account untouched above $400 after the transfer.
Mom said you survived Capitol lawn traffic lol. You actually went?
For like two hours. Marisol wanted company and I was curious. I stood near the edge and left before it got packed.
Edge strategy sounds very you. Did you buy anything from those folding tables?
Just a button and I chipped in a little for the tenant help stack they were photocopying.
Coffee Sunday before dinner? I promise not to make a spreadsheet for the drip machine.
Deal. I already made one for the crown payment and the utility buffer, so the coffee can remain free-range.
Classic Bern. You sleeping or doing the 2 a.m. ceiling stare again?
Some staring, but I am still cooking, texting people back, and excited for chili at Mom's. It is mostly the money math and making sure I did not miss something important.
Did the meeting get weird or just boring weird?
Mostly boring. Trey read my notes first and caught where I had the wrong pay period.
Bless him. Did anyone actually answer the policy question?
Nicole said the handbook is the only version they use and anything about schedule premiums has to be emailed to HR with the form number.
I was going to post that bright graphic from the rally, but it is basically five big words and a sunset photo.
Send me the bill link instead. I want to see who enforces the bad-apartment fines and whether the clinic slots are actually funded.
Very you. I found a PDF, page 14 has the fee table and page 22 has the staffing chart.
Perfect. If that part is real, I will write my comment tomorrow before we cook.
Your mom asked if you made it home before the snow got bad.
Yeah, roads were just wet. I texted her when I parked but I can ring her after dinner.
Good. Also bring that tire gauge next time you come by. Mine wandered off.
I will put it by my keys so I do not forget.
For the tax packet, did you find last year's folder?
Yes. Same setup as last year: W-2, student loan interest, and my own health forms.
Good. Keep the lease copy in there too, since you split housing costs with Lena.
Already added it. I made a tab for Lena bills and a tab for everything under my name.
Mom found the tiny bracelet from St. Joe's. It still has the 6-14 tag on it lol.
That thing survived three moves and somehow looks better than my current keychain.
She also found the family tree worksheet. It is basically Gangaram plus a lot of Miller, Whitaker, and Anderson lines.
Bring it Sunday? The clinic portal keeps asking me to match the same boxes from last year.
Mom found that ancient calculator with the tape roll. She says it survived more fertilizer invoices than we survived math homework.
Tell her not to throw it out. I still remember her punching numbers while three phones rang.
Also she found a folder from that Aurora night class. Perfect handwriting, zero surprise.
Save that too. Her notes are probably better than the textbook.
Coffee after the game tomorrow? I can spot you if that crown thing hit hard.
No spotting. I moved $25 from eating-out money and left the car payment alone.
Responsible sibling energy, boring but powerful.
Also found the clinic form. It only needs W-2s and my lease page, no county letters.
You coming by Mom's early tomorrow? I might bring those new gummies Carlos keeps hyping.
Bring whatever for you all, but leave me out. I am on call Monday and they have been doing random screens again.
Copy that, foreman Bern. Also Dad said he is grilling, so backyard table?
Backyard is fine if we sit away from the ash bucket. I am not driving home smelling like the fire pit.
I found that DAM talk screenshot. Also, your last page with the refinery pipes looked better after you softened the sky.
Send it, please. I am clearing space by the drafting table after groceries and putting on the same Nina Simone record.
Done. Your little shelf of repair books is secretly useful for line work, no matter what you say.
It is. The diagrams keep me from guessing where the valves and cross-bracing go.
Printer at the house is working if you need it tomorrow.
Thanks. I may print the final copy after the app finishes the state part.
Bring the truck insurance paper too. Your mother has folders out already.
I have folders. Work stub from last Friday is saved, and the refund estimate moved only a little after I checked the default option.
Do you need me to bring the folding cot back from the garage Sunday?
For that city survey, keep it short. They read bullet points.
No, keep it there. The hall closet is already tight with just our winter bins.
I wrote: outside review for bad stops, more slow-down training, and plain rules everyone can read.
Ok. Lease papers done?
That is enough. You can mention the wide-load mornings without making it personal.
Almost. Lena signed, I just need to finish my part tonight.
Yeah. I am leaving family stuff out anyway; there is nothing useful to add there.
I looked at the estimate picture you sent. Did they subtract anything after entering the group number?
Not yet. They said the front desk has to resubmit because my new card starts with different letters.
Then wait for the corrected page before you choose a date. Put the amount you can set aside from each paycheck on paper.
I will. I am not booking the permanent piece until the numbers stop moving.
I sent my utilities half. Want me to grab eggs and rice later?
Yes please. I moved Friday's Juniper thing to the 27th, so I'm doing cheap bowls this week.
Works. I can make the black beans tonight if you want some.
Thanks. After the bill shuffle, I would rather do that and keep the nice seasonal-menu night for payday.
Game on at your place today?
Tonight, yes. I may come by early for dinner and head home before the first period.
Your brother sent me that Broncos picture you reposted. He thinks he is funny.
He is not wrong this time. I only reposted because the caption was perfect.
Your dad has his knee appointment Friday. I am making a folder with questions so we do not forget anything.
Good idea. I also printed that March table from the Colorado site for him, since he asked whether he should wait until fall.
Thank you. Did your arms settle down after your pharmacy stop?
Yes, just one evening of soreness. The clinic handout was accurate.
The mixer is still making that scraping sound. Should we just replace it?
Let me try the coupler first. I saved a YouTube teardown where the same noise was one cracked plastic piece.
Fine by me if it doesn't become parts all over the counter.
I'll use a towel and label the screws. Also found a chef clip for fixing the dough texture without running it so hard.
Before your shift, please check whether the dentist office has your updated card on file.
I added it last night. Also requested one of my saved days for the crown follow-up so I do not lose the whole morning.
Good. Keep the confirmation number with your receipts.
Already in the folder with the boot and vest receipts. You trained me too well.
I found the Cherry Creek Schools folder from when you were driving yourself and Marcus still needed pickup notes signed.
That sounds exactly like that year. Please save the emergency card if Dad's old work number is on it.
It is. Same Aurora address too. I will put it with your tax envelope.
My break is short, but I paid the crown installment. Can I call you tonight before 8?
Yes. I will have the notebook out. Your dad also found the socket set you mentioned.
Thanks. I can pick it up when I come over on the 22nd.
Good. We will keep dinner simple that night.
Did you write the crown payment on the calendar? I do not want that one sneaking up on you.
You sounded tired earlier. Did you eat dinner before starting anything else?
I did. I put $300 aside from the first March deposit and will add the rest from the second.
I ate. I am at the table with brushes for thirty minutes, then shower.
Good. Use last month's cushion only once, not as the new pattern.
Good. I found the East High binder in the hall closet. Mr. Kim's note is still tucked in the front sleeve.
Exactly. My sheet still uses $3,800 as the boring number unless overtime shows up.
Can you set it aside? Marisol and I may look at the photos before we go downtown next weekend.
Coffee Sunday? I want the work drama recap lol
Sunday works. Not much drama. Trey helped me compare the new shift chart with my last two checks.
That sounds like math jail.
Pretty much. My deductions are just taxes, insurance, and 401k, so at least the missing premium was easy to spot.
Wind is up this morning. If they let you run the new hire through the trench box demo, slow them down on hand signals.
That’s the plan. I’m using my lunch to tighten the demo outline too.
Good. Keep copies of what you teach. Those hours matter later.
I started a folder with sign-in sheets, outlines, and the machine cards.
Xcel posted. Your half is $64.18. I can pay tonight if you want to send yours tomorrow.
I sent it just now. Also I left a sticky on the door because I kept second-guessing whether I latched it after trash.
Saw it. Door is latched. No new mail except the regular clinic summary envelope.
Thanks. That envelope was just the same visit recap, no new chart line. I am going to shower and watch one episode instead of checking the app again.
Dad wants to know if you still have the photo of him next to that giant scraper thing. The one where his mustache was doing too much.
I think so. It was in the box with the belt buckle and the blue class booklet.
Perfect. He also asked about the tiny plastic cards from his wallet. Guess those matter for the reunion table.
I put them in the same envelope so they do not get lost.
Museum Sunday? There is a 10:30 textile tour, then we could get tacos.
Can we do the 1:00 slot instead? I have my usual lake walk in the morning.
Of course. Your cottonwood appointment wins.
It keeps my head clear without me having to sit through anything organized.
Can you send your utilities half today or tomorrow? No rush, just closing my spreadsheet.
Today is fine. The bank alert came yesterday morning, so I can send it after groceries.
Perfect. Also did you figure out the filing thing?
Yes, submitted last night through the app. It was basically one employer form and the built-in amount, then done.
I am doing laundry at 8. Is your board still set up by the closet?
Yes, but I can move the chair. The pan set and paper are staying on the table until the mountain road dries.
No issue. I just heard the speakers and wanted to check before I ran the washer.
I will keep it low. I am using the road atlas and the highway photo from Dad, so I do not want to pack it up yet.
I am stopping at King Soopers. Anything for the fridge?
Limes and sparkling water if they are on sale. Game night is at our place and I want an easy default after one glass.
Got it. Also your hoodie from the porch chair still smells like last weekend.
I know, I put it by the washer. Please remind people to keep anything leafy outside and not by the kitchen window.
Coffee after Ma's chili tomorrow? Also the parts guys are all mad about the new schedule thing lol.
Coffee works. Tell them to look at the Local 455 sheet, not just the rumor thread. The steward put the overtime language in plain English.
You and your PDFs. Does it say anything useful or just the usual chest beating?
Useful. It names the shift notice window, grievance steps, and who has to answer by day ten.
Coffee before Sunday dinner or are you in full spreadsheet mode again?
